title: For each “shelved_offloaded” instance display name that has extra metadata
question: For each “shelved_offloaded” instance display name that has extra metadata and more than 5 records, show the display name, its computed standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB), the total number of completed migrations for instances with that display name, and the average completed-migration count per qualifying display name. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_display_names AS (
    SELECT i.display_name
    FROM instances i
    JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid
    WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
    GROUP BY i.display_name
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
),
memory_stats AS (
    SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_stddev
    FROM instances i
    WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
      AND i.display_name IN (SELECT display_name FROM qualifying_display_names)
    GROUP BY i.display_name
),
migration_counts AS (
    SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations
    FROM instances i
    JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
    WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
      AND m.status = 'completed'
      AND i.display_name IN (SELECT display_name FROM qualifying_display_names)
    GROUP BY i.display_name
)
SELECT
    ms.display_name,
    ms.memory_stddev,
    COALESCE(mc.completed_migrations, 0) AS total_completed_migrations,
    AVG(COALESCE(mc.completed_migrations, 0)) OVER () AS avg_completed_migrations
FROM memory_stats ms
LEFT JOIN migration_counts mc ON mc.display_name = ms.display_name

WITH q AS (
  SELECT i.display_name
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
  GROUP BY i.display_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
),
m AS (
  SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(mg.id) AS completed_migrations
  FROM instances i
  JOIN migrations mg ON mg.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND mg.status = 'completed'
  WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
  GROUP BY i.display_name
)
SELECT
  i.display_name,
  STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS stddev_memory_mb,
  COALESCE(m.completed_migrations, 0) AS total_completed_migrations,
  AVG(COALESCE(m.completed_migrations, 0)) OVER () AS avg_completed_migrations
FROM instances i
JOIN q ON q.display_name = i.display_name
LEFT JOIN m ON m.display_name = i.display_name
WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
GROUP BY i.display_name, m.completed_migrations;
